searchText: Is EIP 712 the only eSignature document ? eSignature? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-191 is the generic signed text standard. https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-712 is for signing structured data. https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5289 is a _draft_ for making legally binding contracts on-chain. Woah so the EIP 5289 does exist, I had been made aware of it but i was also told it was never published, i may be able to help. Are there any experts i could interview as part of my research vetting process? Legal experts or software experts? the latter unless there are also legal experts I think you'll find an overabundance of software experts and a lack of legal ones in this discord 🤣 But <@267831837240328192> is the author of 5289 if you'd like to chat about its specifics sending you a friend request Sent you a friend request Anyways - there's going to be plenty of updates to 5289 i want to know what those are and learn

excerpts.content: Is EIP 712 the only eSignature document ?

excerpts.author: samwilsn
excerpts.content:
https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-191 is the generic signed text standard.
https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-712 is for signing structured data.
https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5289 is a _draft_ for making legally binding contracts on-chain.
